hero.name: Marco Linardi
hero.intro: A fully scholarship student majoring in Computer Science & Mathematics and a full-stack developer based in Jakarta. I build end-to-end digital products, from frontend and backend development to mobile applications, deployment, and cloud infrastructure.

about.title: About
about.description: I'm a Computer Science and Mathematics scholarship student at Bina Nusantara University with a GPA of 3.73, currently serving as a Senior Laboratory Assistant. As a developer, I focus on building reliable and scalable software across the full development lifecycle, from frontend and backend development to mobile applications, cloud infrastructure, and deployment.

items.title: Laboratory Assistant
items.body: Lecturing lab-based courses at BINUS University — delivering lectures and hands-on sessions, authoring exam and practice cases, and guiding students through real-world project work.

items.title: MAPID See It
items.body: Became a Top Favorite out of 174 teams at the MAPID See It national competition, building an AI- and geospatial-based website.

items.title: ICPC 2025
items.body: Competed in the International Collegiate Programming Contest, solving algorithmic problems under time pressure against university teams worldwide.

items.title: Alibaba Cloud
items.body: Took part in Alibaba Cloud's national competition as a full-stack developer, contributing to Payshield-AI — a team-built project.

items.title: PPTX Automation
items.description: An internal tool for BINUS teaching assistants that generates ready-to-present briefing slides for every teaching session straight from the schedule. Assistants filter their classes by initial, download per-session decks, and copy LINE group links and keys, while admins manage the teaching schedule (.xlsx) and PPTX templates through a file manager panel.

items.title: Arithmancer
items.description: A pixel-art multiplayer math game where players create or join rooms with a code and fight enemies by solving arithmetic problems, either shooting roaming enemies by typing the last digit of their answer or battling in timed turn-based duels where correct answers hit harder and wrong ones cost time.

items.title: MonoClip
items.description: AI-powered desktop video editor that provides professional video editing and AI-assisted features such as automatic transcription, translation, profanity censoring, object tracking, auto-zoom, and background removal, all running locally without requiring a subscription.

items.title: FifteenPadel
items.description: A complete padel club management and booking platform where members can book courts, purchase equipment, register for coaching and memberships, and manage their activities through a personal dashboard, while staff can manage bookings, products, and club operations through an admin panel.

items.title: Twitter Clone
items.description: A social media platform inspired by Twitter/X that allows users to create threaded posts, manage profiles, participate in communities, and interact with a moderation system through an administrative interface.

items.title: MrGamatoto
items.description: A real-time multiplayer mini-game platform featuring multiple competitive games, online rooms and lobbies, player rankings, and a collectible cat system where players can unlock and collect different characters.

items.title: MrTyper
items.description: A typing practice platform that helps users improve their typing speed and accuracy through structured lessons, practice texts, and performance tracking across individual typing sessions.

items.title: Epic Math Saga
items.description: An Android strategy game that combines tactical battles with mathematics challenges, allowing players to manage their base, deploy units, fight enemy waves, and progress through increasingly difficult stages.
